# pokerhud.ai

> Poker analysis (FLIP — legal grey zone in many jurisdictions).
> Open. Transparent. Governed.

## Key facts

- **Domain:** pokerhud.ai
- **Tier:** flip
- **MCP endpoint:** https://pokerhud.ai/mcp (streamable-HTTP, MCP 1.27.2)
- **A2A Agent Card:** https://pokerhud.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- **Open source:** https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/pokerhud-hive (MIT)
- **Pricing (x402 micro-call):** Free
- **Pricing (SaaS tier):** Freemium
- **Memory mode:** shared
- **Knowledge subgraph scope:** poker hands, GTO solutions, ICM, hand histories
